Messages.Author: Francois Villon
Messages.Body:
Is a Day Op. modified action blockable by Allies?
In Daring the Dawn text is specified "Vampires cannot block this action",
but I think is more or less the same point.

Thanx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Francois Villon wrote:
>
> Is a Day Op. modified action blockable by Allies?

No. By card text the action becomes unblockable.
Allies cannot block unblockable actions.
